label: Concept
description: A documented direction that is not presented as implemented.

label: In development
description: Implementation work is active, with confirmed gaps still inside the intended scope.

label: Prototype
description: A working proof or partial workflow that still requires integration and operational hardening.

label: Integrated
description: Confirmed application and service paths work together in the current engineering stack.

label: Pilot-ready foundation
description: The foundation can enter a governed pilot process after deployment-specific acceptance work.

label: Production hardening
description: The implementation exists while security, operations, scale, recovery, and governance are being strengthened.
